name: Andrew Garbarino
stance: As Homeland Security chair, focuses on AI as an emerging security threat, including jailbroken models and adversary misuse, while favoring innovation with safeguards.

statements.text: Chaired a Homeland Security subcommittee hearing on securing AI systems against adversaries who weaponize the technology.

With subcommittee chairs Ogles and Brecheen, asked Anthropic, Google and Quantum Xchange to testify at a Homeland Security hearing after Anthropic reported a largely AI-executed PRC cyber operation using its Claude Code tool.
For the first time, we are seeing a foreign adversary use a commercial AI system to carry out nearly an entire cyber operation with minimal human involvement.
We must ensure America leads in innovation while putting the right safeguards in place.
That includes the dangers posed by jailbroken AI models and the ways this technology can be exploited by bad actors.
Released a Homeland Security Committee chairman's report on how AI is changing the threat landscape and what is needed to keep Americans safe.
